What's new in DuckOS 1.0.44 — the Dynamic Island, reworked

• It hugs the front camera and is always there on your home screen.
• It steps aside when you open an app, so it never covers what you're doing.
• Several live things at once (a timer, the stopwatch, charging) show together — tap to open it and see them all, each with a Stop or Cancel button. The Clock's timer and stopwatch both appear now.
• Smoother, and the tap to open/close is fixed.
